input_prompt: `inventory_hold.py` tracks checkout stock holds in a ledger shaped `{"holds": {hold_id: {"sku", "qty", "placed_at"}}, "by_sku": {sku: [hold_id, ...]}}`. `available_quantity(ledger, sku, on_hand)` subtracts the sum of active holds' `qty` for `sku` from `on_hand`. `release_hold(ledger, hold_id)` currently pops the hold from `ledger["holds"]` but then deletes the ENTIRE `ledger["by_sku"][sku]` list for that hold's sku, instead of removing only `hold_id` from it -- so releasing one hold silently releases every other still-active hold on the same sku too. Fix `release_hold` so it removes only the released hold_id from `ledger["by_sku"][sku]`, leaving other active holds on the same sku untouched. Add a regression test named exactly `test_release_hold_only_removes_target_hold` that places two holds on the SAME sku, releases one, and asserts `available_quantity` still reflects the other hold's reserved quantity.
